description: Mechanics-informed machine learning for geospatial modeling of soil liquefaction: example model implementation in Jupyter Notebook and Matlab is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Morgan Sanger, University of Washington (washington.edu). This code repository contains an example Jupyter Notebook and Matlab script to implement a geospatial liquefaction model. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project with 5 top-level files (M, IPYNB, PDF). Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-sp3e-dp21. Keywords: geospatial, soil liquefaction, hazard modeling. Published 2024-11-27. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 3-Clause BSD License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
